messages:
elaine: heads-up: i found a handful of docs pages still recommending the `embed-old` alias and the Python SDK example in the migration guide uses the v1 client pattern. that will confuse folks when aliases get retired next month.

raj: can you drop the exact broken snippet? i'll take the PR.

elaine: broken Python snippet in guides/migration: 
```py
# legacy v1 style
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=KEY)
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-old', input='hello')
print(resp['data'][0]['embedding'])
```
should be updated to v2 style + explicit fallback note:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=KEY)
# prefer explicit modern alias, fall back to embed-regular-v2 if necessary
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-compact-v2', input='hello')
print(resp.embeddings[0].vector)
```
also add a short callout in the migration guide: if you rely on alias routing, pin an explicit fallback (e.g., `embed-regular-v2`) in your integration.

finn: good catch. i'd update the canonical migration guide + any quickstart embedding snippets. then run a repo grep for `embed-old` and handle remaining hits.

nina: also note for release notes: alias retirement will be gradual but we'll route old aliases for 30 days only. can we add that line to the breaking changes section?

elaine: yes 1: short blurb: "Deprecated embed aliases (e.g., `embed-old`) will be auto-routed for 30 days. Please migrate to explicit aliases like `embed-compact-v2` or provide `embed-regular-v2` as a fallback."

doc-bot: created issue DOCS-9402: Replace deprecated embed aliases in migration guide + update Python snippets. PR recommended. https://git.company.internal/r/redwood/docs/issues/9402 :spiral_note_pad: 

raj: i'll open PR branch docs/replace-embed-old and update Python/TS/Go quickstarts on the migration page. will include a grep test and add the changelog blurb. assign @elaine and @nina.

finn: can we also add a short unit test for the snippet runner to ensure the example parse shape matches the v2 response (embeddings array field name)? that will catch regressions.

raj: yup adding a simple example-smoke test. PR coming in 30m.

elaine: perfect, thanks. once merged i'll ping product for release-note approval. :thumbsup:
